A commitment funds the market’s opening liquidity.

This market is resolved. Committers and liquidity providers claim here: Fuse claims your vault allocation if it hasn't been claimed yet, then your pool share, then pays the winning side in mUSDC. Each receipt is saved as it lands; if a step fails, click again to resume.

Claim LP allocation or request an eligible refund

After a vault launches, claim your LP allocation with the original vault and launched market addresses. If it cannot launch and PREDICT permits a refund, use the vault PDA.

Why this is PREDICT-native: the onchain vault holds user commitments, creates the funding conditions and initializes the market's LP base. Its launched market is then traded on PREDICT's time-aware pm-AMM. An ordinary price feed or side-feature cannot provide this lifecycle.

05 / WHY PREDICT

The right AMM for the right asset.

01

Built for outcomes

YES/NO tokens resolve to 0 or 1. A standard constant-product pool does not match their event-driven risk as expiry approaches.

02

Liquidity throughout the market

The pm-AMM concentrates useful liquidity around uncertain outcomes, with a time-aware design that addresses the changing risk profile. Commitment Vaults let users fund opening liquidity before a market exists.

03

Permissionless, inspectable

We use real PREDICT program instructions and verify Solana transactions. No private order book and no off-chain ledger.

Risk notice: PREDICT currently uses centralized manual market resolution, has upgrade authority risk and has not undergone a third-party security audit. Fuse session limits apply inside this browser. No mainnet funds or financial returns are involved on Solana devnet.
